title: Settings & Species Names
description: Choose name languages, look up available names, and adjust saved training preferences.

steps.title: Choose Your Name Language
steps.description: In 'Settings & Data', set 'Primary Display Language'. Danish is the default, with 12 other vernacular languages and 'Scientific Binomial (Latin)' available. This changes taxon names, not the English interface. Your choice is saved.

steps.title: Look Up Available Names
steps.description: Under 'Species Names', click 'Look Up Names'. Availability is shown for your selected language; a missing result does not mean a local name does not exist. You can train during lookup. Successful results are cached. Use 'Check for Names Again' or 'Retry Name Lookup' as offered; if asked to wait, follow the displayed delay before retrying.

steps.title: Choose Your Training Pool
steps.description: Set 'Minimum Occurrence Threshold' to omit taxa with fewer retained observations. The 'Minimum Occurrence Cutoff (C_min)' control under 'Stage 1 Sampling & Probability Weights' changes the same saved value. This does not delete observations. 'Max Occurrences Per Taxon' is a separate cap applied during import.

steps.title: Choose How Often Taxa Appear
steps.description: Under 'Stage 1 Sampling & Probability Weights', Flat gives eligible taxa equal weight; Natural follows their retained observation counts. Log Transformed and Square-Root Transformed soften the influence of those counts. Counts describe the imported data, not biological abundance. Sampling mode, minimum threshold, language, and theme are saved across launches and dataset clearing.

steps.title: Focus Your Practice
steps.description: Use family and taxon filters to focus on groups you choose, or 'Practice Misidentified Photos Only' to revisit previous mistakes. Family and misidentified-only filters are session controls. If no questions remain, broaden the filters or lower the minimum threshold. Reselect saved training groups if prompted after upgrading.
